note: Per-POI local reassignment (pilot for Mènontin). For each POI matched to quartier X, road vertices within 50 m of the POI are checked; if X does not already own any, a Dijkstra path is sought through the current owner's territory only (barrier: third-party quartier vertices) until X's existing network is reached. The minimum connected branch (Y-seeds in the POI ring plus the path) is reassigned. Audit-only — do not embed in shipped datasets.
